error.internal-error: Something unexpected went wrong. The log file has the details.
error.forbidden-host: This page is not Nyctalus's own page.
error.forbidden-origin: Another web page tried to change Nyctalus.
error.missing-token: Open Nyctalus from the address it showed when it started.
error.invalid-setting: That setting has a value Nyctalus does not accept.
error.library-unavailable: That folder cannot be used as a library.
error.folder-not-writable: Nyctalus cannot write to that folder.
error.not-an-absolute-path: Choose a folder with its full path.
error.site-exists: A site with that name already exists.
error.unknown-species: That species is not in the catalogue.
error.not-a-species: Choose a species, not a genus.
error.file-missing: The recording's file is missing from the library folder.
error.unreadable-recording: The recording's file cannot be read.
error.invalid-slowdown: Playback can be slowed down 1 to 40 times.
error.invalid-spectrogram: Those spectrogram settings are out of range.

abstention.too-short: The recording is too short to judge.
abstention.mixed-sources: Several animals or noise calling at once.
abstention.ruled-out: Every candidate was ruled out, or does not occur here.
abstention.out-of-band: The calls' frequency contradicts the name.
abstention.inconclusive: The calls vote evenly between names.
abstention.uncorroborated: The measurement did not confirm that a bat was there.
abstention.contradicted: Two other methods agree it is a different bat.

note.measured-like-common-pipistrelle: The measured end frequency points to the common pipistrelle.
note.measured-like-nathusius-pipistrelle: The measured end frequency points to Nathusius' or Kuhl's pipistrelle.

skip.not-bat-mode: recorded in a mode other than bat

notice.no-device: Some recordings could not be tied to a recorder.
notice.no-site: Some recordings were made where no site is set up yet.
notice.clock-ahead: Some recordings are dated in the future: the recorder's clock may be fast.

problem.empty-settings: An empty settings file was found.
problem.unreadable-settings: A settings file could not be read.

config_issue.starts-after-sunset: Starts recording at {1}, after sunset at {0}.
config_issue.ends-before-sunrise: Stops recording at {1}, before sunrise at {0}.

common.later: This part arrives in a later version.

welcome.title: Welcome to Nyctalus
welcome.intro: Nyctalus keeps your recordings, and what it finds in them, in a library: one folder you can back up or move as a whole.
welcome.models_intro: One of the identification methods needs about 52 MB of model files. They are downloaded once.
welcome.ready_text: Bring in the recordings from your recorder's card.

settings.title: Settings

pass.key: Field key, from the measured calls

settings.passes_note: BatDetect2 gives the names. The other two methods can only withhold a name they both disagree with.
settings.sieve: Skip the networks for recordings in which no calls were measured
